candidate.title: irCLIP
candidate.scope: The single irCLIP architecture depicted in the assigned Illumina schematic, interpreted with the original irCLIP paper (Zarnegar et al., 2016). It follows UV-C-crosslinked RNA–protein complexes through immunoprecipitation, on-bead trimming, IR800–biotin 3′-adaptor ligation, gel/blot/protease recovery, reverse transcription and affinity capture, then circularization/PCR to a cDNA-derived library. This is a schematic extraction, not a complete implementation recipe. The standalone adaptor key supplies a reagent to the main route; the leftmost irCLIP overview icon identifies the method. There are no depicted alternative target branches.
